limitations: One-dimensional stationary pure-Neumann profiles are proved; temporal stability and classification of all steady states are not. The source paper's mixed time-dependent numerical boundary problem is not covered. The general all-length conclusion assumes the positive-homoclinic condition U_->U_+/2.
provenance: Scientific derivation from the cited porous-diffusion reaction-diffusion model; proof and literature review are documented in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
record_title: Positive Neumann steady patterns at a degenerate porous-diffusion resonance
